empty.title: Create your first envelopes
empty.body: Envelopes are spending categories (Food, Rent, Holidays), collected in groups. Every month you split the money from “Ready to Assign” among them.

auto.title: Funding goals
auto.nothingNoMoney: Nothing to fund — there is no money left to assign.
auto.nothingCovered: Nothing to fund — the goals of visible envelopes are covered this month.
auto.intro: From Ready to Assign, money was added to envelopes with goals:
auto.leftNeeds: Left to assign: <rta/> · goals still need <needed/>.

rta.label: Ready to Assign
rta.negative: You assigned more than you have. Reduce assignments by {{amount}}.
rta.zero: All your money has a job.
rta.positive: Split this money among your envelopes.

summary.label: Month summary
summary.overspentLastMonth: Overspending from {{month}}: <money/> — it reduced Ready to Assign.
summary.assignedInFuture: Assigned to future months: <money/> — this money is no longer in Ready to Assign.
summary.pending_one: {{count}} transaction is waiting for an exchange rate
summary.pending_other: {{count}} transactions are waiting for an exchange rate
summary.pendingNote: — they are not counted yet; the amounts will fill in on their own.

flows.title: Outside envelopes
flows.incomeNote: Income and opening balances of on-budget wallets — they add to Ready to Assign.
flows.uncategorizedNote: Expenses and refunds without an envelope — they come out of Ready to Assign.
flows.transfersNote: Transfers off budget without an envelope and exchange differences between wallets.

tile.label: Budget — {{month}}
tile.noEnvelopes: You have no envelopes yet — create some to plan your spending.

grid.allHidden: All envelopes in this group are hidden.
grid.groupEmpty: This group has no envelopes yet.

state.negative: Overspent — move money to cover the spending
state.underfunded: This month's goal is not covered yet

goal.dateMissing: Enter the date by which you want to save the amount.
goal.datePast: The goal date has passed — choose a future one.

move.title: Move money
move.sameTarget: Choose a destination other than the source.
move.source: Available in the source: <money/>. A move may leave the source in the red — just like with paper envelopes, you will see it right away.

details.activityLoadFailed: Could not load the envelope's transactions
details.activityEmptyBody: Expenses with this envelope will show up here.

group.name: Group name
group.duplicate: A group with this name already exists.

envelope.name: Envelope name
envelope.duplicate: An envelope with this name already exists.
envelope.monthlyHint: How much to assign to this envelope every month, e.g. for food or bills.
envelope.byDateHint: How much to save by the chosen day — we will spread the missing amount evenly over the remaining months.
envelope.hideHint: A hidden envelope disappears from the grid, but its amounts still count in the budget and you can still use it in transactions.

deleteEnvelope.title: Delete envelope {{name}}?
deleteEnvelope.inUseBody: It has transactions — the budget history must stay. You can hide it: it will disappear from the grid and the amounts will stay.
deleteEnvelope.body: The envelope's assignments will disappear and their amount will return to “Ready to Assign”. Payees with this envelope as their default will lose that setting.

deleteGroup.title: Delete group {{name}}?
deleteGroup.notEmptyBody: Only an empty group can be deleted. Move the envelopes to another group or delete them; you can hide envelopes with transactions.
